remarks: Enjoy a rare waterfront setting at 123 Harbor Drive - where everyday living is defined by the rhythm of the water, from peaceful mornings to glowing sunset views. This premier end-unit residence offers exceptional views and a timeless, refined style throughout. Perfectly positioned to capture sweeping water vistas, this sun-filled 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features an open, flowing layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. As an end unit, it offers added privacy and abundant natural light with windows on multiple exposures.  Heat and hot water are included in the HOA, and an attached private garage with direct walk-in access - a rare and highly desirable feature - enhances everyday living. The main-level primary suite allows for easy single-level living, complete with generous closet space and a well-appointed en-suite bath, creating a serene and private retreat within the home.  Hardwood floors run throughout the main living spaces, complementing the inviting living and dining areas set against a beautiful waterfront backdrop. The kitchen offers quality finishes and functional design. Upstairs, a spacious second bedroom with its own full bath and oversized custom closets provides excellent storage and flexibility for guests or a home office. Located in Palmer Landing, just moments from beaches, marinas, dining, and downtown, this home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy refined waterfront living.
